7.3.3.4.3 SOVD
data-categories
Data that can be read or written by SOVD can be grouped into various
data-
categories
. The SOVD request to retrieve
data-categories
is used by the
SOVD client to obtain a list of supported
data-categories
, supported by the SOVD
entity.
Available standard SOVD
data-categories
used within data resource collections
are
identifications
,
measurements
,
parameters
and
system informa-
tion
. Additional custom categories are also possible and can be used.

data-categories
is derived by the
DiagnosticSovdDataCate-
gory
